subject.title: fix: land ten small reliability fixes

question: Should this maintainer-labeled takeover batch remain the landing path after resolving the current conflicts, or should the source fixes be split back into narrower PRs?
rationale: The PR is protected by the `maintainer` label, cannot be merged cleanly as-is, and intentionally combines compatibility-sensitive runtime and automation changes that require maintainer ownership.

options.title: Rebase and keep the batch
options.body: Resolve the conflicts, rerun exact-head proof, and use this PR as the canonical landing path for the included source fixes.

options.title: Split the batch
options.body: Land the lower-risk source fixes separately if the combined conflict or validation surface is too broad.

options.title: Pause the takeover
options.body: Leave the source PRs as the review path if maintainers do not want one combined reliability batch.

recommendation.title: Rebase and keep the batch
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts, rerun exact-head proof, and use this PR as the canonical landing path for the included source fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the takeover commits and also appear in current-main history for several central touched paths.
